verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature. Data could only be pulled out programmatically through the V4 API: personal API keys, cursor-paginated list endpoints, custom fields and broadcast stats. The remote MCP server also exposes subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments. This is a do-it-yourself extraction path rather than a supported 'export everything and leave' capability. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export, open file formats (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), export coverage of all data types such as emails, forms and automations, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on confirmation of a successful export.
